name: Windrose
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install a Windrose server and run it. **ATTENTION:** First startup can take a long time since it downloads the server files and installs the runtimes! **NOTE:** After first startup of the server, shut it down and edit the following files to your liking: - YOUR_INSTALL_PATH/R5/ServerDescription.json - YOUR_INSTALL_PATH/R5/Saved/SaveProfiles/Default/RocksDB/_gameVersion_/Worlds/_worldId_/WorldDescription.json The invite code used to join the server will be in ServerDescription.json Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available.

ports.name: Game TCP Port
ports.description: Only put a port here if using Direct IP connection (default value is 7777)

ports.name: Game UDP Port
ports.description: Only put a port here if using Direct IP connection (default value is 7777)

variables.name: Game ID
variables.description: The game ID that the container download at startup. (https://steamdb.info/)

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.
